questions.stem: Why does breathing rate remain elevated for some time after exercise stops?

options.text: Because the lungs need time to repair
To repay the oxygen debt by breaking down lactic acid
Because the brain forgets to slow breathing down

questions.explanation: After exercise, the body needs extra oxygen to break down the lactic acid that accumulated during anaerobic respiration. This is called repaying the oxygen debt, and it is why breathing stays fast after stopping.
